interpretation.primary_comparison: Minimum modelled T count among all implemented baseline candidates satisfying the same qubit cap and operator-error budget.
interpretation.compiled_portfolio: No additional qubit cap beyond the configured, actually compiled baseline portfolio; not an unrestricted optimization over every possible implementation.
interpretation.tt_width: Baseline candidates may use up to the exact TT circuit width; both sides satisfy that same cap.
interpretation.pareto: Two objectives: allocated logical qubits and modelled T count. Circuit depth, CNOTs, compilation time and physical overhead are not Pareto objectives here.
interpretation.cap_intervals: A strict-win interval starts at the TT width and ends just before the first compiled baseline with no greater T cost becomes feasible. SelectSwap block sizes are powers of two, so other lookup variants could fill gaps.
interpretation.infeasible: A TT circuit wider than the fixed cap is excluded from both wins and losses at that cap.
interpretation.accuracy: Each method must have measured finite-grid potential-phase error at most tolerance/2; the remaining tolerance/2 is a prospective rotation-synthesis budget.
interpretation.model: Primary ceil(3 log2(1/delta)+10) and sensitivity ceil(4 log2(1/delta)+10) per arbitrary rotation; exact CCX costs 7T.
interpretation.claim_scope: Logical circuit tradeoffs for the implemented coherent circuits. No physical fault-tolerant execution, global synthesis optimality, new algorithm theorem or computational quantum advantage is established.
